name: Drone
summary: Scan a room to reveal hidden defenders. Completing a scan can trigger operator-specific drone effects.

name: Breach Charge
summary: Throwable/deployable charge used to destroy light walls, barricades, and similar partitions.

name: Claymore
summary: Proximity mine that triggers when an opposing operator enters its covered space.

name: Frag Grenade
summary: Throwable grenade that damages operators and gadgets in the targeted room.

name: Stun Grenade
summary: Throwable flash that applies a stunned marker to operators in the targeted room.

name: Smoke Grenade
summary: Places a smoke overlay that blocks line of sight in its spaces.

name: Hard Breach Charge
summary: Charge that can destroy fortified/reinforced walls the standard breach cannot.

name: Barbed Wire
summary: Setup obstacle that costs extra movement to enter or leave its spaces.

name: Nitro Cell
summary: Throwable explosive that damages operators and destroys gadgets in the targeted room.

name: Deployable Shield
summary: Portable cover that grants protection and can block lines of sight or movement.

name: Bulletproof Camera
summary: Setup camera that grants information; it remains visible and can be destroyed.

name: Impact Grenade
summary: Throwable that can destroy light walls, barricades, and nearby gadgets.
